metadata.description: Benedictine missal with notated chants for a church of St Ambrose in the province of Ravenna, 11th century. Central Italian neumes without a staff. The gradual of St Agnes, f. 29v.
metadata.title: Missale
metadata.transcription: Read sign by sign from the Walters' 300 dpi photograph of f. 29v by two independent readers, October 2026; the zones are on The Digital Walters' JPEG of the same photograph (1067 x 1800 px); see research/diffusa-est/staff-readings/README.md.
